purpose: Evaluate C0-B3 and E3-B3 inference combinations against four verified historical Validation128 conditions; inference only.
rgb_contract: uint8 RGB HxWx3, 0..255 at inference entry; frozen preprocessing converts once to float32 0..1 then ImageNet normalization.

base_model.id: Depth Anything V2 Metric Outdoor Small

T2_E3-B3.checkpoint: E3 epoch5, selected by the prior formal study

b3.tile_start_rule: round(tile_size*(1-overlap)); final tile anchored to far image edge; no padding
b3.tile_weight: positive Hann: max(np.hanning(n), 1e-3), outer product; normalized weighted average
b3.lowpass: normalized 215x215 box filter, OpenCV BORDER_REFLECT_101, original image coordinate grid
b3.precision: FP32; TF32 disabled; no clipping or GT-based affine correction

historical_conditions.epoch20-B3: reused from multiscale_tile_inference_20261016/per_image_metrics.csv after one-image B3 code-path reproduction gate

visualization_indices_source: First row for each crop x view stratum in the previously fixed 16-image B-series pilot_selection.csv; locked before this experiment's results.
